title: Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.05953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory. As these systems evolve toward the agentic era, graphs also organize execution dependencies and multi-agent communication, linking intermediate observations and retained information to subsequent decisions. However, understanding their contribution requires distinguishing the function of each graph operation, the component responsible for its computation, and the subsequent use of its output. This survey introduces an operation-level role--locus taxonomy for reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination. We compare how graph observations and external computations guide decisions, how memory representations and updates support later tasks, and how dependencies constrain execution and information delivery. translated_title: 智能体时代中图介导的大语言模型系统：推理、知识、检索、执行与协调
translated_abstract: 图在大语言模型（LLM）系统中发挥着日益重要的作用，支撑结构化推理、知识落地、检索与记忆。随着这些系统向智能体时代演进，图还被用于组织执行依赖关系和多智能体通信，将中间观察结果与保留的信息同后续决策联系起来。然而，要理解图的贡献，必须区分每个图操作的功能、负责其计算的组件以及其输出的后续使用方式。本综述提出了一种操作层面的“角色—位置”分类法，涵盖推理、知识与证据、检索与记忆、执行以及协调五个方面。我们比较了图观察和外部计算如何引导决策、记忆表示与更新如何支持后续任务，以及依赖关系如何约束执行与信息传递。这些比较区分了改进……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本综述提出操作层面的“角色—位置”分类法，系统刻画了图在智能体时代大语言模型系统中于推理、知识与证据、检索与记忆、执行及协调五大环节中的功能、计算来源与输出用途。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces an operation-level role–locus taxonomy that systematically characterizes how graphs contribute across reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination in agentic LLM systems.
